facts.text: Melanie and her family went on a camping trip that took place yesterday, which was a way to relax after a road trip.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Caroline! Yup, we just did it yesterday! The kids loved it and it was a nice way to relax after the road trip.

facts.text: Melanie mentioned that having her family around helps her during difficult times and provides support.

They're a real support. Appreciate them a lot.
